headline: Sensex Soars 1,500 Points, Nifty Surges Above 25,700 Led by Foreign Inflows and Strong Sector Gains

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Foreign fund inflows supported strong early market buying.
Lower crude oil prices boosted broader market sentiment.
Indian equities rebounded as an AI selloff deepened across Asia.
Rupee strengthened 23 paise to 92.62 against the U.S. dollar in early trade.
whatHappening: Sensex rallied up to 1,500 points while Nifty 50 crossed 25,700 levels.
India VIX dropped 7%, signalling reduced market volatility.
Banking and IT stocks led the broad market rally, while BSE Insurance Index gained 2.5%.
Gold prices fell below Rs 1,22,000 per 10 grams and silver slipped to Rs 1,45,000 per kg.
summary: Indian benchmark indices opened sharply higher on November 25, 2026, with the Sensex surging up to 1,500 points and Nifty approaching 25,750. The rally was fueled by foreign fund inflows, falling crude oil prices, and strength in banking and IT heavyweights. Volatility cooled down significantly as the India VIX dropped 7% while the Rupee strengthened.
